variances.variance: Not built with the kit: its own environment repository, no system.json, apps that declare themselves in apps/<app>.yaml
variances.reason: A delivery platform designed on its own ("the platform is app-neutral and the apps are platform-neutral"), earlier than the kit and kept as it is

variances.variance: Builds run in Codefresh, not in GitHub Actions
variances.reason: One verb per tool: Codefresh builds, Octopus releases, Argo CD applies (README of its environment repository). The fleet reads its builds as commit statuses

variances.variance: Project sandbox is the platform's conformance fixture, not a product: its uat and prod stay behind tdd between conformance runs
variances.reason: apps/sandbox.yaml (ADR-IR34): the only target of destructive tests, in nonprod only; lifecycle platform-standard promotes it to uat and prod by hand, and only the conformance suite does. Declared by the system's owner on 2026-10-07

variances.variance: Promotion to uat and prod is automatic, with no sign-off
variances.reason: Its lifecycle platform-continuous promotes tdd, uat and prod automatically; no approvals by design (apps/workorders.yaml)

variances.variance: Follows none of the kit's templates
variances.reason: What it is made of is its own (principle 007): its own clusters, Argo CD, SQL Server Express per app

variances.variance: Sleeps by default: the clusters of tdd, uat and prod are stopped outside 07:00 to 19:00 Central on weekdays and after 120 idle minutes; only an Octopus or Codefresh job wakes them
variances.reason: Cost: an unreachable node is normal most of the time (docs/runbooks/sleep-and-wake.md of its environment repository; stated by its owner session, 2026-10-07)

variances.variance: Three clusters: nonprod (tdd and uat), prod, and a build cluster for Codefresh that never stops
variances.reason: Its own design: builds are separated from where apps run (stated by its owner session, 2026-10-07)

variances.variance: The database is SQL Server 2022 Express in the cluster, one per environment, not a managed database
variances.reason: Its own application architecture (principle 007; stated by its owner session, 2026-10-07)

variances.variance: The deployed version is pinned as image tags in gitops/apps/<app>/envs/<env>/app/kustomization.yaml, committed by Octopus and applied by Argo CD; there is no versions.json
variances.reason: Argo CD applies what Git says; the pin commit is the record (stated by its owner session, 2026-10-07)

variances.variance: Production is frozen every weekend, Saturday 00:00 to Monday 00:00 UTC; promotion is otherwise automatic
variances.reason: A standing deployment freeze. The fleet allows its environments 72 hours behind the first one instead of 24 (fleet.promotionLagHours), so a weekend is not a finding (stated by its owner session, 2026-10-07)

variances.variance: Its dashboard is served by GitHub Pages from its own repository, with a committed topology; it is not released through Octopus
variances.reason: Its own design (stated by its owner session, 2026-10-07)

variances.variance: GitHub Actions workflows are not its gates: codefresh/ci, codefresh/release and codefresh/env-checks are. The app repository still has a legacy Actions build whose job Publish Release Candidate fails on every run
variances.reason: One verb per tool: Codefresh builds. The fleet reads its commit statuses and raises no finding for its Actions workflows (stated by its owner session, 2026-10-07)
